'''Alexander Meseguer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (Jedi Pack Han)]], according to Derek Halpern's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d703">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00d703/ ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00], DeckTech (Derek "Datasta" Halpern, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00d703/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
